description: Catch up: what a person or group did and where they were named in a window, newest first per kind (mail by thread). who: a name (fuzzy; close matches return ambiguous [{name, hash}]), email, hash:<8 hex>, team:<slug>, org:<name>, new:<window>, a phrase ('the core team') or a list. Kinds: waiting (one person, no topic: what is on their radar, each with its rule (reply_to_you > called_out > to_cc > named, then commitfest and cfbot rules (Needs review not when they wrote the entry's newest message; cfbot_not_applying_your_patch: cfbot cannot apply the newest patch they posted, whatever their role), then code_changed: open patches changing files they wrote much of on master, in threads they have not posted in: group code_changes, with files and share, score, proposer, patch_url; called_out items carry call_out {evidence, excerpt, confidence, url} quoting the ask), group, priority 0-100, why, and outlook (unit commitfest = P(commit) for the CF and release and thread health, in an open commitfest; unit thread = p_commit within horizon_days for a patch thread in no commitfest; people to seek out, factors, model_version)), acted (what they did about it: answered, sent_patch, committed, with what asked and when; an item leaves waiting when they act), mail_from, mail_to_cc, mail_mention, git_author, git_credit, git_mention, wiki_edit, wiki_mention, commitfest, calendar, roster. waiting mail items carry p_more_replies (P(another message within 60 days)), p_reply (P(the person posts within 60 days); live items ordered by it) and reply {factors, cell_n, model_version}; threads called finished (a commit, a closed entry, quiet past the list's threshold, or a last message that only thanks or reports the work done: done_reason acknowledged / work_done with done_why) are left out and counted in left_out {count, by_reason, by_rule} unless done=show. Names, hashes and urls only, never addresses. ~4 s budget; late kinds in timed_out with partial=true. Cite each url. Same as GET /api/v2/activity.

done.description: waiting: hide (default) finished threads, or show them after the live ones

during.description: Calendar event uid or url, or pg19: its dates

since.description: 2026-10-01, 2w, 14d, 1m, today, pg19 (its development window), all (default 14 days ago)

topic.description: Narrows every kind by hybrid search, e.g. NUMA

who.description: 'Tom Lane', team:core-team, org:Amazon/AWS, new:30d, an 8-hex hash, an email; or a list

name: whats_new
